unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Make up a conversation about bamboo and its importance.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀法: important (重要的) + ce (名词后缀) -> 重要性。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I was deeply impressed by her fluent English and confident smile.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她流利的英语和自信的微笑给我留下了深刻的印象。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: im-(进入) + press(压) -> 印在脑海里 -> 印象深刻的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to make a good first impression.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根词缀：impress（印）+ ion（名词后缀）= 印象。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: His cooking needs improvement.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：improve（改进）+ ment（名词后缀） -> 改进，改善。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fifty guests came to the party, including several foreign students.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 五十位客人来参加了聚会，其中包括几名外国学生。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: include(动词：包括) + -ing(变成介词)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Going away to university helped him learn a lot about independence.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 去外地上大学帮他学到了很多关于独立的知识。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: in-(否定) + depend(依靠) + -ence(名词后缀) -> 不依赖他人 -> 独立

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 独立的；自主的；公正的；自治的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Going away to college has made me much more independent.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：in（否定前缀）+ dependent（依赖的） -> 独立的，自主的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This city is well known as an important industrial center.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这座城市作为重要的工业中心而闻名。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: industry(工业) + -al(形容词后缀) -> 工业的

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Today's choices will influence your future.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: in + flu(流) + ence -> 像一股水流注入其中产生影响。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (食物、产品等的)成分，材料；(成功的)因素，要素
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We need eggs, tomatoes, and other ingredients.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: in(里)+gred(步)+ient(名后缀)：走入锅里的东西，就是食材。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 灵感；妙计；鼓舞人心的；启发灵感的人(或事物)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The short story was actually the inspiration for the internet!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: inspire(启发)的名词形式 inspiration(灵感)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Emotional intelligence helps us build relationships.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: intelligent(聪明的)的名词形式 intelligence。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dolphins are known to be highly intelligent marine animals.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 海豚以高度聪明的海洋动物而闻名。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：intel(英特尔芯片)使电脑更聪明 -> intelligent 聪明的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 接受采访者；参加面试者
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The interviewee answered all the questions calmly and professionally.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 受访者冷静而专业地回答了所有问题。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: interview(面试) + -ee(受动者，如employee) -> 被面试的人

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 新闻记者，新闻工作者
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The journalist traveled to the front line to report the latest news.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 记者前往前线报道最新消息。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: journal(日志、期刊) + -ist(……的人) -> 记录新闻的人 -> 记者

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The landscape there was amazing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 合成词: land (土地) + scape (景象) -> 土地上的景象就是风景。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 生活方式；工作方式
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eating healthy food and exercising regularly are key to a healthy lifestyle.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 健康饮食和规律锻炼是健康生活方式的关键。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: life(生活) + style(风格) -> 生活方式

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Oh! And now there's lightning!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词根记忆：light (光) + ning -> 像光一样闪过的现象。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Haley Evans has always had a special place in her heart for literature.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：liter（文字）+ ature（名词后缀） -> 文字构成的艺术即“文学；文献”。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: adj. 无意义的；不重要的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Arguments without clear facts and logic are completely meaningless.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 没有清晰事实和逻辑的争论是完全毫无意义的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: meaning(意义) + -less(无，没有) -> 没有意义的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 微波，微波炉 v. 用微波炉加热
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can you please microwave the leftover pizza for me?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你能帮我用微波炉加热一下剩下的披萨吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: micro(微小的) + wave(波浪) -> 微波(炉)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The weather is extremely hot in midsummer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mid(中间) + summer(夏天) -> 夏天的正中间 -> 仲夏

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We should be careful because some online advertisements can be misleading.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们应当小心，因为一些网络广告可能会误导人。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mis-(错误) + lead(引领) + -ing -> 把人带错方向 -> 误导的

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 月光；夜间潜逃 v. (暗中)兼职
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They took a romantic walk along the beach in the soft moonlight.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他们在柔和的月光下沿着海滩浪漫散步。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: moon(月亮) + light(光) -> 月光

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is a quiet and friendly neighborhood to live in.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这是一个居住安静且友好的街区。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: neighbor(邻居) + -hood(名词后缀，表示状态或群体) -> 邻居居住的街区

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little boy got a nosebleed because the air in the room was too dry.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小男孩流鼻血了，因为房间里的空气太干燥。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: nose(鼻子) + bleed(出血) -> 鼻出血

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. (已承诺的或法律等规定的)义务；责任
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Parents have a legal obligation to send their children to school.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 父母有法律义务送子女去学校上学。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: obliga(绑、束缚) + -tion(名词后缀) -> 必须履行的法律或道义束缚 -> 义务

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She works for a charitable organization that helps homeless people.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她在一家救助无家可归者的慈善机构工作。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: organize(组织) + -ation(名词后缀) -> 组织、机构
